commentary.text: Short of a length, pitching outside off stump once more. Shubman Gill moves onto the back foot and cuts for a single run.
SIX! Short ball, pitching outside off. Kohli pushes forward and pulls for a half dozen runs.
FOUR! On a good length, pitching outside off stump once more. Kohli gets on the front foot and drives over the off side for 4 runs.
FOUR MORE! Full ball, on leg stump again. Kohli moves onto the front foot and plays a glance on the leg side for four runs.
Good length from Lawes, pitching outside leg and angled across. Kohli moves onto the front foot and glances for one run.
Good length, pitching outside leg stump and angling across. Shubman Gill moves onto the back foot and guides a glance for a run back behind square.
Good length from Lawes, pitching outside leg stump and angling across Kohli. He goes back and plays a defensive stroke for one run.
Pitched up, outside leg again. Shubman Gill gets forward and eases a drive for a run through the on side field.
Back of a length from Joseph, pitching outside off stump. Shubman Gill pushes forward and cuts poorly for 1 run.
Length ball, outside off stump again. Shubman Gill gets forward and eases a drive for a single run on the off side.
FOUR! Pitched up, outside off stump once again. Kohli gets forward and drives over the off side field for four runs.
Short of a length, outside off stump again. Kohli gets on the front foot and punches a sloppy drive for one run past the bowler.
On a good length, pitching outside leg and angling across the batter. Kohli goes back and drives for one run through the leg side field.
Chase pitches one up, on leg stump and angled across Shubman Gill. He gets on the back foot and drives for a run.
Good length from Chase, outside leg and angled across the batter. Kohli gets on the back foot and punches a drive for a single run.

OUT! Caught. Dropped in short by Joseph, pitching outside off. Kohli goes back and guides a late cut back behind point. WEST INDIES appeal for a catch. The umpires meet and decide to call for an umpire review. The decision has been made by the third umpire, and Kohli has to go.
Good length from Joseph, outside off stump once more. Shubman Gill moves onto the front foot and tucks a glance back behind square for a run.
Pitches up on a good length, and Gaikwad defends back down the pitch.
Short of a length, outside off stump. Gaikwad opens the face and finds the gap for a single.
Wide. Short of a length, pitching well down the leg side.
Short of a length, outside off stump. Gaikwad swings and misses, and the ball rolls away to the keeper for a single bye.
Full and straight, and Gaikwad is beaten by the pace on the outside.
Short of a length, pitching on a good line but angling across the batter. There is a nick off the pads to leg for a single leg bye.
No ball. Good length, pitching outside off stump. Gaikwad gets on the front foot and eases a drive through the off side field for a single run.
Length outside off, and Gaikwad waits on it before working a single into the deep.
